instructions: A real custodian or operator must fill every placeholder after a factual review.
Each completed subject must be self-digested and status=sealed before a gate wrapper can reference it.
Each completed gate wrapper requires a real non-empty human_attestation; this command never creates one.
Do not use this template as a pass receipt or an authority input.
For G10, retain empty mounts only with separate_uid; mount_isolation requires distinct candidate, evaluator, and builder mount identifiers.
